name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in the provinces of Salta and Catamarca, Argentina. The Diablillos Project is a large-scale silver-gold deposit at the advanced development stage, having received environmental approval from Salta authorities in 2026 and approval under Argentina's RIGI investment incentive regime. The company also trades on the OTCQX under the symbol ABBRF.
